title: The fastest-growing sport in the world

copy.heading: The fastest-growing sport in the world
body: Padel may well be the fastest-growing sport in the world. The engagement has no reason to doubt it. The problem is how often you tell people.

Over the scoping period you said it 212 times. You said it to the midwife, the vicar, a man selling you a car, two members of the local council and Mia's swimming teacher, who is an Olympian. You said it on a first date with Lauren's sister's new boyfriend, who was not on a date with you. You once said it in your sleep, and Lauren wrote it down.
Nobody disputes the figure. They would only like to hear about something else that is growing. The children, for example, are also growing, and quite fast.
